uninstallAppDesc.mac: Clear login credentials first (optionally config/cache), then quit TabTin and move it from Finder → Applications to the Trash.
uninstallAppDesc.linux: Clear login credentials first (optionally config/cache), then uninstall TabTin with the software manager used to install it.
